items.title: Richard McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: I bought the clarinet for him. I think he got hurt by an automobile and he died. His name was John. He was a real old drummer, old-time drummer, John Dean.

ctx.x: I went to a fellow named Correll, that's the same, Cindy Correll's brother. His brother was a violin player. His name was George. I went up there to him, he said, well, I'm gonna tell you, he said, banjo, that's a funny instrument. He said, why don't you learn how to play some other instrument, and then you can figure out how to play that banjo by me. I said, well, what instrument would you suggest? He said, well, I don't know. What you think you'd like to play? I said, well, I always just like to play. I always…
People tell me you were a wonderful banjo player. That's the truth.
